# Rox Boxing Gym (ROX)

> Bangalore's First Full-Ring Boxing Gym: Beginner Friendly, Defense-Coach Led.
> Culture: "Sweat, Blood & Glory"

## Overview
- **Brand:** Rox Boxing Gym (wordmark: ROX)
- **Website:** https://roxboxing.com
- **Founded:** April 10, 2018 by Ex. Capt. Rakesh S
- **Facility:** 5,000 sq. ft. dedicated boxing gym with a 20' x 20' indoor platform ring
- **Affiliation:** Karnataka Amateur Boxing Association (KABA)
- **Curriculum:** 4-level certified boxing curriculum
- **Amenities:** Boxing Reading Library, In-house equipment store, Changing rooms, 2-wheeler parking
- **Reputation:** 4.9/5 across 280+ Google reviews (Trustindex-verified)

## Locations & Hours (Asia/Kolkata, IST)

## Coaches
- **Ex. Capt. Rakesh S:** Founder & Head Coach; ex-Army officer; trained under Dennis Swamy (8x National Champion, Arjuna Award winner).
- **Narendra N:** 20 years' experience; 5x State Gold; Senior Nationals Silver.
- **Sagar:** 10+ years' experience; 3x State/National Gold.
- **Roshni:** 7+ years' experience; participant, 2024 All India Inter-University.
